title: It’s worth the 2 hour bus...
text: It’s worth the 2 hour bus ride from Seville.  Well organized.   The ‘hike’ is more of a walk and it’s easy walking.  As long as you are not afraid of the heights this excursion is for you…esp after spending a couple of days in Seville.   It’s nice to get a break from all that eating and drinking!!

title: Caminito del Rey
text: Fantastic beautiful trip and with us we had Carlos Leon who was a really good and knowledgeable guide and at Caminito Del Rey Lilly who gave us history as natural science knowledge along the way and felt safe.
author: tanjakA1763LN

text:
The view was breathtaking! 
I booked tickets for an individual tour and don't regret it for a moment. 

You can travel the route at your own pace and stop where you want. 

Even though a lot of people come to the Caminito, there are times when I didn't see anyone in front or behind me. 

It is very clean
author: AnkeV307

title: A magical place, land, water and sky
text: Super positive experience for this tours, all punctual as scheduled with a guide our era Ines that explains with passion and knowledge the best of the region you were going to visit. Honest price , the landscapes are amazing... super happy to have lived such a beautiful experience!
author: Rihanna2079

title: 100% recommended
text: I wanted to go to Ronda and my husband found this excursion. I doubted because I wanted to go to Ronda alone, but I really loved the excursion. They give you 30 min in the two white villages that are very beautiful and time is enough to see them. Also 3 hours in Ronda, the place is beautiful and has beautiful scenery. 100% recommend the tour.
author: lizandrah2017

title: Great experience, but too long.
text: The walking experience is definitely worth the travel, and the guides were good. However, I purposely booked a trip that avoided a stop and tour at Osuna to cut the tour time down. On board the bus, we found that it was going to stop and, therefore, arrived back 2.5 hours later than expected. Not really a problem to us, but for some, it was. Also, lots of hanging around.
author: David A
